name: Synthesa - Medical Affairs decision makers (Pharma / Medical Device / Biotech)
notes: Extracted from the 2026-06-19 onboarding call transcript (Synthesa.docx). Synthesa is an AI-enabled medical-evidence consultancy (systematic literature reviews / meta-analyses answering a client's clinical question from published evidence) selling into three sub-verticals with DIFFERENT decision-maker titles and DIFFERENT size rules, which this flat schema can't express as one query - see bronze/clay's build_people_query, which only ANDs one job_title list against one industry/size/location scope. This file is the reference/union ICP; the actual live search for synthesa_people_table_v1.csv ran as two separate segment queries: (1) Pharma + Medical Device: job titles Chief Medical Officer / Director of Medical Affairs / VP Medical Affairs / VP Strategy, no size cap (Medical Device explicitly 'regardless of size'; Pharma's ~5,000-employee number was stated as an ideal, not a hard cutoff). (2) Biotech: job titles Founder / CEO / Chief Scientific Officer (biotech is pre-medical-affairs-department stage; decision maker is usually the founder, who typically has a medical/scientific background). End target across all segments is the prescribing physician, not the patient - Medical Affairs is 'marketing to doctors' backed by literature evidence, not commercial/patient marketing. Geography: all of Europe + North America (US, Canada) + UK explicitly called out; Japan and China explicitly ruled out ('different culture, different way of doing business') - hq_countries above is a representative EU/EEA + UK + US/Canada list, not exhaustive of every European enum value.
